cards.title: Component Basics
cards.content:
@Component Decorator

Components are the main building block of Angular. Each component has a class, an HTML template, and CSS styles.

@Component({
  selector: 'app-hello',
  template: '<h1>Hello!</h1>'
})
export class HelloComponent {}

cards.title: Input & Output
cards.content:
Data Passing

Use @Input() to pass data into a component and @Output() with EventEmitter to emit events to a parent component.

cards.title: Lifecycle Hooks
cards.content:
Component Lifecycle

Angular provides lifecycle hooks to tap into key moments. ngOnInit is called after inputs are initialized. ngOnDestroy is called before the component is destroyed.
